purpose: Inspect model filament paths at the remaining small forming corner; no printer submission or full production readiness claim.
scope: One local mold-forming corner, using nominal emitted filament footprints and layer connections. No physical forming accuracy, adhesion, casting, seal force, water exclusion or lifetime result. No printer submission.

measurement.method: Buffer positive model G1/G2/G3 paths by half their declared width; supports are excluded from the local path reading. Arcs use the repository arc reader with at most 0.18 mm path segments. Compare the nominal footprints with native STL layer-midplane sections and the preceding layer. Segment counts include linearized arcs.

decision: Retain this local functional forming corner. The native paths grow from solid layers and remain connected in the inspected region. Nominal tip rounding is recorded; full forming-surface accuracy after finishing remains unqualified.
